'''Andrew Meyer''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[July 2001 Toronto tournament]] on 14 July 2001 with [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed|Rebel Strike Team (copy of Lingrell's)]], according to Spencer Ball's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2653">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-17-ball-goes-to-toronto-nexus-x-july-14d2653/ ball-goes-to-toronto-nexus-x-july-14], DeckTech (Spencer "s_ skywalker" Ball, 17 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-17-ball-goes-to-toronto-nexus-x-july-14d2653/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
